questions.question: mis-selection plan grill found a real bug: today the Budget side of the join admits EVERY active DUB budget GL, so a mapped selection can return Budget rows for GLs outside its resolved set — breaking acceptance criterion 1 ('exactly the DUB nursery slice'). The fix is to restrict Budget to the resolved master GL set. But that creates a mirror of the Actuals gap decision 0018 solved: Budget GLs present in the active budget batch but ABSENT from the mapping master would silently vanish from the report. How should unmapped BUDGET GLs be handled?
